openDecisions: Part E — Civil engineering technical electives (36 credit points, single-degree students only) is a ~35-unit pool (Level 3/4/5: bridges into transport/traffic, water/hydrology, geotechnical, structures, plus cross-listed Resources Engineering and a few Level 5 postgrad-adjacent units) — deliberately NOT enumerated here, same call already made for Economics' elective pool and Business Analytics-adjacent lists in commerce.json: too large/open to be useful as catalog cards. Add specific ones as custom units once chosen. Double-degree students (e.g. a hypothetical Civil+Commerce) have this 36cp requirement waived entirely per the Handbook — 'already credited towards the double degree structure'.

CIV4286 (Project management for civil engineers) is GONE from the current Handbook entirely (404, and a site search returns zero results) — this is past the 2024 vintage's 'replace with a Professional Practice unit' instruction, the code itself no longer exists to enrol in. Removed from the catalog outright (2026-09-14) rather than kept as a stub — same 'not in the catalog at all, add the real replacement as a custom unit' treatment already used for ECE4099 in electrical.json.
Part D (Professional practice) requires ENG0001 at Clayton (ENG0002 at Malaysia) — already satisfied by electrical.json's ENG0001 entry (discipline:"common"), no new unit added here.

Year/semester placement for all 14 Civil-specific units below is Claude's suggested sequencing (unit level + validated prerequisite/corequisite chains, cross-checked so nothing is placed before its real prerequisites and every placement matches its actual Handbook-verified offering semester), not an official Monash course-map fact — see sources note above for why the actual PDF couldn't be fetched this session.

2026-09-14 re-audit findings (see PROGRESS.md for full detail): CIV3294 was wrongly marked 'both semesters'/Y3S2 — it's actually Semester 1 only, the exact bug Sahel's friend reported, now fixed (also required moving CIV2206 earlier to keep the prerequisite chain valid). CIV4249 (previously 'not offered') is now genuinely offered Semester 1 only. Several prohibition codes had gone stale as Monash retired old unit codes (CIV2241, CIV3264, CIV3222, CIV2226) and in three cases introduced new postgraduate-level equivalents (CIV5170, CIV5149, CIV5178) — all updated to match the current Handbook.

units.title: Structural materials
units.prerequisiteText: ENG1011 Engineering methods OR ENG1001 Engineering design: Lighter, faster, stronger
units.notes: Semester 2 offering only (Clayton and Malaysia). Prohibited combination with CIV2225 (Design of steel and timber structures) and CIV3284 (Design of concrete and masonry structures) — older predecessor units this one appears to have absorbed/superseded.

units.title: Geomechanics 1
units.prerequisiteText: Completion of 30 credit points of engineering study (Master of Professional Engineering E6011 students exempt).
units.notes: Semester 2 offering only (Clayton and Malaysia). 2026 Handbook re-audit: the unit page no longer has a Requisites tab at all — the old ENG1011+ENG1014 unit-code prerequisites and the CIV2241 prohibition are gone, replaced by a generic 30cp-of-engineering-study rule under Rules > Enrolment Rule (CIV2241 itself is now retired/404 in the current Handbook). By this unit's Y2S2 placement, first-year units already clear the 30cp threshold anyway, so the placement itself is unaffected.

units.title: Structural mechanics
units.prerequisiteText: ENG1011 Engineering methods OR ENG1001 Engineering design: Lighter, faster, stronger
units.notes: Semester 1 offering only (Clayton and Malaysia). Y3S1 placement is the earliest valid S1 slot given ENG1011 itself sits at Y2S1 in this catalog's shared common-first-year.json (Sahel's own foundation-maths pathway pushes it back from the standard Y1S2) — couldn't move this earlier without landing in the same semester as its own prerequisite.

units.title: Water systems

units.notes: Semester 1 offering only (Clayton and Malaysia). A special course-specific rule lets E3009 (Architectural Design double degree) students take ENG1005 and (ENG1014 or ENG1060) as corequisites instead of prerequisites — not applicable here.

units.title: Transport and traffic engineering
units.notes: Semester 1 offering only (Clayton and Malaysia). No Requisites/Rules section exists at all on the 2024 Handbook page — genuinely no prerequisites, corequisites, or prohibitions.

units.title: Building structures and technology
units.prerequisiteText: (CIV2225 Design of steel and timber structures OR CIV2235 Structural materials) AND CIV2206 Structural mechanics
units.notes: Semester 2 offering only (Clayton and Malaysia). CIV2225 is CIV2235's older predecessor (the two prohibit each other) — CIV2235 used as the representative prerequisite code since it's the currently-taught unit.

units.title: Geomechanics 2
units.prerequisiteText: CIV2242 Geomechanics 1 AND CIV2206 Structural mechanics

units.title: Road engineering
units.notes: Semester 2 offering only (Clayton and Malaysia). Prohibited combination with CIV4287 (same title — appears to be the Malaysia-specific code for identical content) and CIV5177 (Advanced road engineering, postgraduate level).

units.title: Structural design
units.prerequisiteText: (CIV2225 Design of steel and timber structures OR CIV2235 Structural materials) AND CIV2206 Structural mechanics
units.notes: Sahel's Civil-engineering friend flagged this as wrong (2026-09-14), and he's right: confirmed against the live Handbook, this is Semester 1 offering only (Clayton and Malaysia), NOT both semesters as the 2024-sourced data claimed — semesterOffered corrected to "1". Kept at its Y3S2 canonical slot rather than moved, though, same treatment as ECE3161 in electrical.json: its own prerequisite CIV2206 is stuck at Y3S1 (the earliest slot that clears ENG1011's Y2S1 placement, see CIV2206's notes), so the only chronologically-clean S1 slot for this unit would be Y4S1 — which collides with CIV4280 needing this unit done first, also at Y4S1. Y3S2 preserves the whole downstream chain (CIV4280 Y4S1, CIV4212 Y4S2) correctly ordered; the tradeoff is this unit will now correctly show an off-semester flag at its own canonical placement, which is accurate — it genuinely doesn't fit a clean 4-year S1 slot given how late ENG1011 lands in this particular first-year pathway. Warn-not-block is exactly for surfacing this kind of real tension rather than hiding it.

units.title: Engineering hydrology
units.prerequisiteText: CIV2263 Water systems AND ENG2005 Advanced engineering mathematics
units.notes: Semester 1 offering only (Clayton and Malaysia) — no Semester 2 offering exists. 2026 re-audit: the CIV3264 prohibition is stale, that code is retired/404 in the current Handbook; the current unit page has no Prohibition subsection at all.

units.title: Bridge design and assessment
units.prerequisiteText: (CIV3284 Design of concrete and masonry structures OR CIV3294 Structural design) AND CIV3221 Building structures and technology
units.notes: Semester 1 offering only (Clayton and Malaysia) — no Semester 2 offering exists. 2026 re-audit: prohibition updated from CIV3222 (now retired/404) to CIV5170, the current postgraduate-level 'Bridge design and assessment' equivalent.

units.title: Civil and environmental engineering practice
units.prerequisiteText: No formal Requisites section — the rule lives as free text under Rules > Enrolment Rule. Civil engineering students: (CIV2282 OR CIV3283) AND CIV3221 AND (CIV3247 OR CIV3248) AND (CIV3294 Structural design OR CIV3284 Design of concrete and masonry structures OR CIV2226) AND (CIV3285 Engineering hydrology OR CIV3264). Environmental engineering students use an entirely different rule: (ENE3031 AND ENE3032) OR [ENE3606 AND (ENE2021 OR ENE3048) AND (CIV3285 OR CIV3264)] — not applicable to this Civil-only catalog.
units.notes: Handbook Overview calls this 'a capstone unit drawing together material from previous units' for a multi-disciplinary design project — kept as type "specialisation" (the degree's actual capstone is ENG4701/ENG4702, shared with Electrical). Semester 2 offering only (Clayton and Malaysia). 2026 re-audit: the Handbook's own free-text enrolment rule still names CIV2226 and CIV3264 as OR-branches for two of its clauses — both are retired/404 in the current Handbook (Monash hasn't cleaned up its own rule text), so in practice only the CIV3247/CIV3248 and CIV3294/CIV3284 branches are live options; doesn't change this catalog's `prerequisites` array, which already used the live representative codes.

units.title: Foundation engineering
units.notes: 2026 re-audit: no longer "not offered" as the 2024 Handbook had it — now genuinely offered, Semester 1 only (Clayton and Malaysia), so semesterOffered corrected from "unknown" to "1" and moved from its old Y4S2 placeholder slot to Y4S1 to match. Also picked up a new prohibition, CIV5149 (the postgraduate-level equivalent), not present in the 2024 data since this unit didn't run that year.

units.title: Water treatment
units.prerequisiteText: CIV2263 Water systems AND CIV3285 Engineering hydrology
units.notes: Semester 2 offering only (Clayton and Malaysia) — no Semester 1 offering exists. 2026 re-audit: prohibition updated from CIV3264 (now retired/404) to CIV5178, the current postgraduate-level 'Advanced water treatment' equivalent.
